description: A finished figure from lab files in one call, as image content plus what was drawn (series, data read, ranges, units, marked peaks). Name data by file and selector, never by pasting numbers: traces and sweeps, chromatograms (TIC, XIC) and the spectrum at an rt or the TIC apex, plate wells by range or layout group (curves per well, or mean ± spread per group), FCS dot plots coloured by gate population and histograms, f–I curves, dose-response and standard-curve fits, a table file's columns (openreadout_batch output); small inline values are allowed. Several files overlay; facet=series gives small multiples, facet=plate plate positions; panels side by side; annotate with bands, lines, labelled points, arrows. Draws only; openreadout_export saves the figure.

Annotation.description: One annotation, in the coordinates the picture shows: full-resolution pixels on images (as on the rulers), axis units on plots (as on the tick labels), and on plate curve grids the time and value axes every card shares.

channel.description: Trace previews with several panels: the channel whose panel it goes in (default: the first panel).

color.description: `accent` (default, warm red), `ink`, `muted`, `white`, another colour name or `#RRGGBB`.

facet.description: Plots with small multiples: the one small plot it goes in, by its title (e.g. `B3` or `sweep 6`; default: every one).

label.description: Text drawn with the mark (the text itself for type text).

type.description: What to draw. `point` = a dot at x, y (with its label beside it); `box` = a rectangle: corner x, y and width, height; `polygon` = a closed outline through points; `line` = an open line through points; `arrow` = an arrow from x, y (where the label goes) to x2, y2; `text` = the label alone, at x, y; `vline` = a vertical line at x; `hline` = a horizontal line at y; `vband` = a vertical band from x to x2; `hband` = a horizontal band from y to y2; `well` = a ring around a plate well (well; previews of plates only).

well.description: Plate previews: the well (e.g. `B3`) for type well, or the one card a mark goes in on a curve grid (default: every card).

x.description: point, text: position; box: corner; arrow: tail; vline, vband: x (vband from x to x2).

y.description: point, text: position; box: corner; arrow: tail; hline, hband: y (hband from y to y2).

label.description: Axis label (default from the data, with its unit).

range.description: Range shown, `[low, high]`. On x, y fits the data inside it unless y has a range.

reverse.description: High to low (default for NMR ppm and IR wavenumbers).

unit.description: Time unit to show a time axis in (`s`, `min`, `h`). Default chosen from the span.

anyOf.description: A rule on each well's value at one x.
Named classes of wells: `{"crashed": "E3:H11,A9:D11"}`; other wells are the rest.

at.description: Where to look, in x-axis units (time in the unit the axis shows).

below.description: Flag wells whose value is below this...

else.description: Name of the other wells. Default "other".

x.description: x values: numbers, or category names.

annotate.description: Bands, lines, labelled points, arrows, boxes and notes, in the units the axes show: the same annotations as openreadout_preview (`facet` picks one small plot).

column_labels.description: Column headings of a plate facet (e.g. doses), left to right.

data.description: What to draw: one series spec or a list of them, drawn in order (first at the back).

facet.description: Small multiples: `series` = one small plot per series (sweeps, files, groups, wells); `plate` = plate wells in their plate positions.

file.description: The file of every series here that names no file, table or values. Alone, without `data`, it draws the file's default view.

legend.description: How series are named: `direct` labels at the line ends, a `key` row, or `none`. Default direct when it fits, else key.

row_labels.description: Row headings of a plate facet, top to bottom. Default: the layout group of each block of rows, else the row letters.

stack.description: Offset each series upward by this fraction of the tallest one (stacked spectra).

assay.description: dose_response, standard_curve: the plate-reader assay arguments without file (layout, standards, model, normalize, reduce, …).

by.description: Plates: `well` (one curve per well, default) or `group` (mean and spread per layout group). Tables: the column whose values split rows into series.

channel.description: Channel index. Default 0 (Sweeps: the voltage channel).

chromatogram.description: Chromatogram: `tic` (default) or `bpc`; ignored when mz is given.

color.description: Colour: ink, accent, muted, faint, blue, ochre, green, purple, teal, brown, or #RRGGBB.

color_by.description: Plate wells: colour by `group`, `row`, `column` or `growth` (grew, crashed, crashed then regrew, no growth, from the growth analysis); by classes `{"crashed": "E3:H11"}`; or by a rule `{"at": 6, "below": 0.1, "label": "crashed", "else": "grew"}` (at in x units).

error.description: Table column with error bar half-widths.

file.description: Instrument file(s); several files give one series each.

groups.description: Plates: only wells of these layout groups (`*` matches any text).

line.description: Profile: the line `[[x0, y0], [x1, y1]]` in the image's full-resolution pixels.

mark.description: How to draw it (default from what it shows).

mz.description: Chromatogram: extracted-ion m/z value(s), one series each.

peaks.description: Label the N highest peaks (chromatograms: rt; spectra: m/z or x).

populations.description: FCS: populations to colour (paths or unique names; needs workspace or gatingml).

read.description: Plates: read number or label (default the first).

rt.description: Spectrum: retention time in minutes, or "apex" (the TIC's highest point).

select.description: Profile: the plane, e.g. `z=12` or `c=1,t=3` (default c=0, the middle z, t=0).

show.description: What to show. Default from the file: trace (signals, 1-D spectra; an Illumina run's quality by cycle, one sweep per lane), chromatogram (mass spectrometry; spectrum with rt or scan), wells (plates), events (FCS with x and y; histogram with x only), amplification (qPCR), histogram (FASTQ and BAM read lengths), frames (movies and image series), sanger (ABI Sanger reads). `trace` = A sampled signal or 1-D spectrum (trace, sweep, channel); `sweeps` = Patch-clamp sweeps (sweep = which; spikes marks action potentials); `chromatogram` = A chromatogram: TIC (default), BPC, XIC (mz) or a detector trace; `spectrum` = One mass spectrum (rt, or scan); `wells` = Plate-reader wells: kinetic curves, or values per well; `events` = FCS events: x against y (points or density), coloured by population; `histogram` = Histogram of one parameter or column (x); `fi` = Patch-clamp f–I: spikes in the stimulus (or y=rate_hz) against injected current; `dose_response` = Dose-response points and fitted curves per compound; `standard_curve` = Standard curve: standards, fit and back-calculated samples; `amplification` = qPCR amplification curves; `melt` = qPCR melt curves (−dF/dT); `profile` = Image values along a line (line, image, select), against distance in mm or µm; `frames` = One value per frame of an image (y: a value the frames record such as dose, or a pixel statistic mean, sum, max, min) against the frame number (x: t, or a recorded value); `sanger` = A Sanger read (ABI .ab1): the four bases' traces against base position, the called bases above and each call's quality below. x_range or the x range is in bases (default about 80 bases where the quality turns good).

spread.description: Spread drawn around group means. Default sd.

subtract.description: Plates: subtract blanks or each well's first reading. Default none.

sweep.description: Sweep index, or a list (sweeps). Default 0 (Sweeps: all).

table.description: A table file (.csv, .tsv, .parquet, .jsonl; e.g. openreadout_batch output) to plot columns x, y (and error) of.

values.description: Small inline data the agent computed: `{x: [...], y: [...], error?: [...]}`; x may be category names.

wells.description: Plates and qPCR: wells such as `A1:H11` or `A1,B2`.

x.description: FCS parameter, table column, f–I measure, or frames: t or a recorded value, for the x axis; histogram: the column to bin (read files: `length` by default, `mean_quality`; nanopore reads: `duration`).

x_range.description: Only this window of the x axis, `[a, b]` in the axis' units.

y.description: FCS parameter, table column, f–I measure (`spike_count`, `rate_hz`), a trace channel by name (an Illumina run: `percent_q30`, `mean_qscore`, `error_rate`, `intensity_a`), or frames: a recorded value (`dose`) or mean, sum, max, min, for the y axis.

annotate.description: Bands, lines, labelled points, arrows, boxes and notes, in the units the axes show: the same annotations as openreadout_preview (`facet` picks one small plot).

caption.description: Small print under the figure (a source credit, a method note).

column_labels.description: Column headings of a plate facet (e.g. doses), left to right.

columns.description: Panels (or facets of a single panel) per row. Default: all panels in one row; facets in a near-square grid.

data.description: What to draw: one series spec or a list of them, drawn in order (first at the back).

facet.description: Small multiples: `series` = one small plot per series (sweeps, files, groups, wells); `plate` = plate wells in their plate positions.

file.description: The file of every series here that names no file, table or values. Alone, without `data`, it draws the file's default view.

height.description: Height in px (default from the content, at most 3000).

legend.description: How series are named: `direct` labels at the line ends, a `key` row, or `none`. Default direct when it fits, else key.

panels.description: Several panels, side by side (see columns); instead of a top-level `data`.

row_labels.description: Row headings of a plate facet, top to bottom. Default: the layout group of each block of rows, else the row letters.

share.description: Panels that share an axis range. Default none.

stack.description: Offset each series upward by this fraction of the tallest one (stacked spectra).

strict.description: true: refuse values this file's assurance does not validate (exit_code 6, with a hint).

name: openreadout_plot

scale.description: `linear`, `log`, `category` or the transform of a flow axis (`logicle`).

unit.description: Unit of the values shown (annotations use it).

class.description: Colour class (group, flag) when the series is coloured by one.

count.description: Series summarized in this entry (many wells of one colour class are listed once).

data.description: What was read: trace, sweep and channel, chromatogram, scan, wells, columns, ...

file.description: The file read (absent for inline values).

marked.description: Labelled spots (peaks, apex, spikes): `[x, y]` in axis units with their text.

x_range.description: x range of the data, in the axis units.

inline_series.description: Series drawn from inline values (numbers the caller supplied, not read from a file).

notes.description: What was done to the data (subtractions, fits, transforms).

save.description: How to save this figure to a file (MCP: the openreadout_export call).

warnings.description: Data that could not be drawn as asked, or values to double-check.
